The '''Elkit Peninsula''' was a peninsula on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. It was known for its variety of aquacultured [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and [[Plant/Legends|plants]], which were used by [[Aquatic Integrated Systems]].
